title: AI-Based Product Recommendation
tagline: Suggests what someone's actually likely to buy.

meta.title: AI-Based Product Recommendation | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Suggests what someone's actually likely to buy.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Generic recommendations convert poorly — without real personalization, retailers leave sales on the table and customers see products that don't match their interests.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Collaborative and content-based filtering combine with reinforcement learning to keep recommendations improving as more behavior data comes in.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Higher conversion and a shopping experience that feels tailored to the individual.
